title: ModMaker project file (.mmproj)
description: A user's in-progress mod. A SPARSE override document: it stores only values that differ from the definition bundle's generated defaults, keyed by leaf id. Never a full snapshot. Sparseness maps directly onto the generated DLC, which mounts above Project Milan - anything absent here is absent there and simply inherits.

format.description: Project schema version. A loader that sees a higher value must refuse cleanly and tell the user to update Mod Manager, never partially parse.

kind.description: Magic string, so a stray .json is not mistaken for a project.

requireAllPlayers.description: Drops the DLC's DLCSetupCanMisMatch mount flag, so the game will not put this player in a lobby with anyone who does not have the mod. Off by default: config differences do desync host and clients, but not usually harmfully, and a mod that cannot be played with strangers costs more than the desync for most of what ModMaker builds.

revision.description: Incremented on each compile, mirroring the old server-side revision counter.

image.description: Mod banner: either a path relative to the project file, or a data: URI.

bundle.description: Which definition bundle this project was last edited against. A mismatch is a warning with a diff, not a refusal.

game.description: The game the bundle was generated from. LMP is Project Milan's own identity; LE3 is what a bundle generated from a stock Legendary Edition install reports.

values.description: Sparse map of "<classId>[@<instance>]/<leafId>" -> overridden value, with a [dimensionKey] suffix for repeated properties. The class qualifier is required because a cascaded property is editable on every subclass that inherits it. The @instance segment appears only for instance-scoped properties on a per-object-config class, so every key written under the class-only model stays valid. Keys not present inherit - from an edited ancestor class in this same project if there is one, otherwise from the game. Keys unknown to the current bundle MUST be preserved on round-trip, not dropped.

instances.description: Instances the USER created, keyed by class id - never a copy of what the bundle already ships. Only meaningful for a class whose perObject.canCreate is true; a config section alone does not make the game construct an object.

collections.description: Payloads for the structured editors, keyed by collection id. Shape is defined by each collection's own schemaRef.
